## About
Our outdoor sign says it plainly: Summit, serving Decatur. Even so, customers come from all over the metro area for car care that is efficient, current, careful and fairly priced.
Summit Auto Service is a complete car care shop with a full line of up to date diagnostic, repair and maintenance services for most imports. Owner Marc Eson and the shop are equipped and trained to handle manufacturer’s scheduled maintenance and keep your dealer warranty intact.
Neighbors rate us 4.4 from 196 Google reviews, and longtime customers tell us they keep coming back for honest, thorough work without the overselling.

## Services
- Manufacturer’s scheduled maintenance: Factory-recommended maintenance on all the makes we service.
- Oil and filter change: Routine oil and filter service for your car.
- Diagnostics: Up to date diagnostic work to find out what's going on with your car.
- Belt and hose replacement: Replacing worn belts and hoses before they leave you stuck.
- Shocks and struts: Shock and strut work for a steadier ride.
- Exhaust and muffler systems: Repair and service for your exhaust and muffler.
- Tire balancing and battery check: Balancing your tires and checking your battery.
- A/C repair and service: Getting your air conditioning working right again.

## FAQ
Q: Which makes do you work on?
A: Most imports, including Acura, Honda, Hyundai, Infiniti, Isuzu, Kia, Lexus, Mazda, Mitsubishi, Nissan, Saab, Scion, Subaru, Suzuki, Toyota, Volkswagen and Volvo.

Q: Where is the shop?
A: We're at 173 DeKalb Industrial Way in Decatur, near Your DeKalb Farmer’s Market.

Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Is there somewhere to wait nearby?
A: Some customers walk down to Waller's Coffee while we take care of quicker jobs like an oil change.

## What customers say

And the work is excellent and fairly priced. Also when I sold my cars, they provided a comprehensive record of all services, no charge. You're probably not going to find a perfect mechanic; if you need a solid one that you can count on, call Summit. Thanks Summit." (Michelle Hiskey, 5/5)
